event.title: Deep Matters 2026
event.about: The Deep Matters conference series is back! This year, we explore how AI agents are transforming the way science is done — from hypothesis generation to decision making to knowledge discovery. Don't miss this one-day event tailored for everyone in academia, industry and startups.
event.registerNote: Free · Limited places, subject to approval.

venue.name: Institute of Physics
venue.directions: 5 mins walk from King's Cross St Pancras

sheares-toh.name: Sheares Toh
sheares-toh.bio: Sheares is a PhD student in the TLDR group at the Dyson School of Design Engineering. He is an avid chess player and a watch aficionado.

sam-cooper.name: Sam Cooper
sam-cooper.role: Professor in AI for Materials Design
sam-cooper.bio: Sam leads the Tools for Learning, Design and Research (TLDR) research group in the Dyson School of Design Engineering. He is also co-founder and Chief Scientist of Polaron.

items.title: Registration & Networking
items.description: Pick up your badge and mingle around. Light refreshments will be served.

items.title: Networking
items.description: Enjoy your final conversations with fellow attendees and speakers. Drinks will be served.
